name: Adaptive Ease

intent_defaults.description: A garment starting point for user-defined dressing, mobility, posture and sensory requirements.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-defined; no assumed body or mobility profile

component_defaults.closure: User-selectable magnetic, loop, zipper, snap, tie or conventional closure subject to material and safety review
component_defaults.access: Optional seated access and task-specific reach

accessibility_defaults: Ask the wearer which tasks and postures matter; do not infer disability or diagnosis.
Test closure operation with the intended user and use context.
Allow seated and standing fit views where relevant.
circularity_defaults: Prefer replaceable closures and components when they improve maintainability without compromising user needs.
caveats: Adaptive features require wearer-led evaluation; this preset is not a clinical or medical recommendation.
Closure suitability, skin contact, load capacity and safety must be evaluated for the selected garment and use.
